updates.content: Crypto gotta bottom around GTA release or the multiplayer release, and then GTA narratives will valhalla
There will be a 9 fig GTA narra, place your bets
There will be a 9 fig GTA, place your bets
Remains my top pick for the big gta ticker gamble, but I think its worth diversifying at least 2 or 3

Frontruns for GTA 

The same way GTA 5 was a huge leap from GTA 4 in terms of car customization, owning property, and other features, I expect GTA 6 to make a similar leap. They've been working on this game for 10+ years, so I expect a lot of new features.

With that being said, I think GTA 6 will have an app where you can trade crypto, meaning DacityCoin will need a clean ticker.

They've already shown DacityCoin three times, and there are even missions involving the coin, so it's clearly important.

You're not going to log into GTA and see something like DacityCoin-AudaCity on a trading app. It just looks ugly asf.

$DTC — Rockstar loves doing parodies. They already memed the NASDAQ with BAWSAQ, so I could see them doing something similar with DTC.

$AU — The only thing DacityCoin is missing to spell AudaCity is AU.

$DCT — Sounds like Dacity.

$DC — The D and C are both capitalized in DacityCoin.

I'm also in a few other coins as a hedge in case they don't go the traditional ticker route.

$DacityCoin — DacityCoin

$DACITY — DacityCoin

If there isn't an actual ticker, I expect them to go this route. Both look cleaner than DacityCoin-AudaCity.

I also think GTA 6 will bring back stocks.

We've already seen companies from GTA 5 returning in the trailers, like Fleeca Bank, so I'm pretty confident the stock exchange will be back.

Stocks and crypto are 10x more popular among young adults than they were in 2013, so I don't see Rockstar leaving them out.

The reason I'm mentioning this is because AudaCity is a company in GTA 6, and since pretty much every company in GTA 5 had a stock ticker, I expect AudaCity to be listed on BAWSAQ too.

That's why I'm also prerunning potential AudaCity tickers, since I think they'll be the best beta to DacityCoin.

$AUD — AudaCity

$AUDA — AudaCity

$AC — Audacity
